card.name: Enemy Controller
card.officialText: Activate 1 of these effects; target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls and change its battle position; OR Tribute 1 monster, then target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls and take control of that target until the End Phase.

behavior: Quick-Play Spell from hand during own Main/Battle priority, or set face-down in a prior turn and activated during own priority or an explicit chain-response window
position mode targets a face-up opposing monster and toggles ATK/DEF, respecting an existing position lock
control mode pays one non-token monster as Tribute at activation, then takes control of a face-up opposing monster until the End Phase
target binding prevents stale zone/epoch references; control is revalidated at resolution
temporary control uses returnTo/returnTurn consumed by the existing End Phase engine cleanup
physical owner UID is preserved; Tributes and the Spell go to their physical owners' Graveyards
negation/invalid target do not refund Tribute; activationId replay protection is JSON-persistent

limitations: Adapter permanece isolado; carta não certificada nem disponível em decks até integração ao resolver v9 e catálogo.
Tributar Tokens foi deliberadamente excluído porque a integração com tokenLedger não está liberada; testes não certificam esse caso.
Alvos que já têm retorno temporário de controle são rejeitados para não sobrescrever pilhas de retorno ainda não modeladas.
Testes offline; sem gateway/guild Discord real.
